steps.name: place-initial-sofa
steps.eval: window.__store.getState().setItems([{ id: 'v-sofa-1', defId: 'sofa-3seat', position: [9, 3], rotation: 0, props: {} }])

steps.name: seed-saved-version-in-localstorage
steps.eval: (() => { const st = window.__store.getState(); const savedAt = new Date().toISOString(); const state = { version: 2, apartmentId: 'serangoon-north-vista-4r', items: st.items, doors: st.doors, finishes: st.finishes, userFurniture: [], userMaterials: [], timeMode: st.timeMode || 'manual', manualHour: st.manualHour || 13, cameraMode: st.cameraMode || 'orbit', savedAt }; localStorage.setItem('sofa-so-good:save:test-v1', JSON.stringify(state)); const idx = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('sofa-so-good:save-index') || '[]'); idx.push({ slot: 'test-v1', savedAt }); localStorage.setItem('sofa-so-good:save-index', JSON.stringify(idx)); })()

steps.name: assert-item-count-before-restore
steps.eval: if (window.__store.getState().items.length !== 2) throw new Error('Expected 2 items before restore, got ' + window.__store.getState().items.length)

steps.name: click-compare-button
steps.eval: (() => { const btns = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('#versionsPanel button')); const compareBtn = btns.find(b => b.textContent?.includes('Compare') && !b.className.includes('del')); if (!compareBtn) throw new Error('Compare button not found in versions panel'); compareBtn.click(); })()

steps.name: assert-diff-visible
steps.eval: if (!document.querySelector('#versionsPanel .ver-diff')) throw new Error('ver-diff element not found after clicking Compare')

steps.name: click-restore-button
steps.eval: (() => { const btns = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('#versionsPanel button')); const restoreBtn = btns.find(b => b.textContent?.includes('Restore')); if (!restoreBtn) throw new Error('Restore button not found in versions panel'); restoreBtn.click(); })()

steps.name: assert-restore-round-trip
steps.eval: (() => { const items = window.__store.getState().items; if (items.length !== 1) throw new Error('After restore: expected 1 item, got ' + items.length); if (items[0].defId !== 'sofa-3seat') throw new Error('After restore: expected sofa-3seat, got ' + items[0].defId); })()
